show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Max Frumes and Sujeet Indap –Inside the Sausage Factory of the Caesar's Restructuring (Capital Allocators, EP.209)
summary:
This show is an open exploration of the people and process
behind capital allocation. It's mostly going well, but they're frustrated that the business
itself isn't quite getting the valuation that a traditional hospitality company will get. There were investment-grade bonds, so they were
relatively low risk at the time.
